leftEvidence.title: Jesus shows hands and side, speaks peace, and sends the disciples

points.label: Doors and presence
points.left: Jesus comes among a fearful group behind locked doors.
points.right: Eight days later he again comes with doors shut while Thomas is present.

points.label: Wounds and response
points.left: The disciples rejoice after seeing hands and side.
points.right: Thomas is invited to examine and answers with a confession.

payload.posture: Keep each Scripture witness intact, inspect what each states, and do not supply a combined sequence the sources do not author.

rightEvidence.title: Thomas’s demand is answered by an invitation and confession

payload.tension: The same bodily evidence addresses a group and an absent-then-present disciple in different sequences.
payload.title: The group sees wounds / Thomas asks to see and touch
